aey nabi ! Allah say dartay raho , aur kafiron aur munafiqon ka kehna matt maano .   beyshak Allah boht ilm wala , bara hikmat wala hai .
aur tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tum per jo wahi bheji jarahi hai uss ki perwi kero , tum jo kuch kertay ho , Allah yaqeeni tor per uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
aur Allah per bharosa rakho , aur kaam bananey kay liye Allah bilkul kafi hai .

Allah ney kissi bhi shaks kay seenay mein do dil peda nahi kiye ,   aur tum apni jinn biwiyon ko maa ki pusht say tashbeeh de detay ho , unn ko tumhari maa nahi banaya ,   aur naa tumharay mun bolay beton ko tumhara haqeeqi beta qarar diya hai . yeh to baaten hi baaten hain jo tum apney mun say keh detay ho , aur Allah wohi baat kehta hai jo haq ho , aur wohi sahih raasta batlata hai .

tum inn ( mun bolay beton ) ko inn kay apney baapon kay naam say pukara kero .   yehi tareeqa Allah kay nazdeek pooray insaf ka hai . aur agar tumhen unn kay baap maloom naa hon , to woh tumharay deeni bhai aur tumharay dost hain .   aur tum say jo ghalati hojaye uss ki wajeh say tum per koi gunah nahi hoga , albatta jo baat tum apney dilon say jaan boojh ker kero , ( uss per gunah hai . ) beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

emaan walon kay liye yeh nabi unn ki apni janon say bhi ziyada qareeb tarr hain , aur inn ki biwiyan unn ki mayen hain . iss kay bawajood Allah ki kitab kay mutabiq pet kay rishta daar doosray mominon aur mohajreen kay muqablay mein aik doosray per ( meeras kay moamlay mein ) ziyada haq rakhtay hain ,   illa yeh kay tum apney doston ( kay haq mein koi wasiyyat ker kay unn ) kay sath koi naiki kerlo . yeh baat kitab mein likhi hoi hai .

aur ( aey payghumber ! ) woh waqt yaad rakho jab hum ney tamam nabiyon say ehad liya tha , aur tum say bhi , aur nooh aur Ibrahim aur musa aur essa ibn-e-maryam say bhi . aur hum ney unn say nihayat pukhta ehad liya tha .
takay Allah sachay logon  say unn ki sachai kay baaray mein poochay .   aur uss ney kafiron kay liye to aik dardnak azab tayyar ker rakha hai .

aey emaan walo ! yaad kero Allah ney uss waqt tum per kaisa inaam kiya jab tum per boht say lashkar charh aaye thay , phir hum ney unn per aik aandhi bhi bheji , aur aesay lashkar bhi jo tumhen nazar nahi aatay thay .   aur tum jo kuch ker rahey thay , Allah uss ko dekh raha tha .

yaad kero jab woh tum per tumharay oopper say bhi charh aaye thay aur tumharay neechay say bhi ,   aur jab aankhen pathra gaee then , aur kalejay mun ko aagaye thay , aur tum Allah kay baaray mein tarah tarah ki baaten sochney lagay thay .
uss moaqa per emaan walon ki bari aazmaesh hoi , aur unhen aik sakht bhonchal mein daal ker hella daala gaya .
aur yaad kero jab munafiqeen aur woh log jinn kay dilon mein rog hai , yeh keh rahey thay kay :  Allah aur uss kay Rasool ney hum say jo wada kiya hai , woh dhokay kay siwa kuch nahi .

aur jab unhi mein say kuch logon  ney kaha tha kay :  yasrab kay logo ! tumharay liye yahan thehrney ka koi moaqa nahi hai , bus wapis loat jao .  aur unhi mein say kuch log nabi say yeh keh ker ( ghar janey ki ) ijazat maang rahey thay kay :  humaray ghar ghair mehfooz hain    halankay woh ghair mehfooz nahi thay , balkay unn ka maqsad sirf yeh tha kay ( kissi tarah ) bhag kharray hon .

aur agar dushman madiney mein chaaron taraf say aa-ghusay , phir unn say fasad mein shamil honey ko kaha jaye to yeh uss mein zaroor shamil hojayen gay , aur ( uss waqt ) gharon mein thoray hi thehren gay .
aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay enhon ney Allah say pehlay yeh ehad ker rakha tha kay woh peeth pher ker nahi jayen gay . aur Allah say kiye huye ehad ki baaz purs zaroor ho ker rahey gi .

. ( aey payghumber ! inn say ) keh do kay :  agar tum moat say ya qatal say bhag bhi jao to yeh bhagna tumhen koi faeeda nahi dey ga , aur uss soorat mein tumhen ( zindagi ka ) lutf uthaney ka jo moaqa diya jaye ga , woh thora hi saa hoga .

kaho kay :  kon hai jo tumhen Allah say bacha sakay , agar woh tumhen koi burai phonchaney ka irada kerlay , ya ( woh kon hai jo uss ki rehmat ko rok sakay , ) agar woh tum per rehmat kernay ka irada kerlay-?  aur Allah kay siwa inn logon  ko naa koi rakhwala mil sakta hai , naa koi madadgaar .

Allah tum mein say unn logon  ko khoob janta hai jo ( jihad mein ) rukawat daaltay hain , aur apney bhaiyon say kehtay hain kay :  humaray paas chalay aao    aur khud larraee mein aatay nahi , aur aatay hain to boht kam .

. ( aur woh bhi ) tumharay sath lalach rakhtay huye .   chunacheh jab khatray ka moaqa aajata hai to woh tumhari taraf chakrai hoi aankhon say iss tarah dekhtay hain jaisay kissi per moat ki ghashi taari horahi ho . phir jab khatra door hojata hai to tumharay samney maal ki hirs mein tez tez zabanen chalatay hain .   yeh log hergiz emaan nahi laye hain , iss liye Allah ney inn kay aemal zaya kerdiye hain . aur yeh baat Allah kay liye boht aasaan hai .

woh yeh samajh rahey hain kay ( dushmanon kay ) lashkar abhi gaye nahi hain . aur agar woh lashkar ( dobara ) aajayen to inn ki khuwaish yeh hogi kay woh dehaat mein jaker rahen , ( aur wahin bethay huye ) tumhari khabren maloom kertay rahen . aur agar tumharay darmiyan rahey bhi to larraee mein thora hi hissa len gay .

haqeeqat yeh hai kay tumharay liye Rasool Allah ki zaat mein aik behtareen namoona hai , her uss shaks kay liye jo Allah say aur yoam-e-aakhirat say umeed rakhta ho , aur kasrat say Allah ka ziker kerta ho .

aur jo log emaan rakhtay hain , jab unhon ney ( dushman kay ) lashkaron ko dekha tha to unhon ney yeh kaha tha kay :  yeh wohi baat hai jiss ka wada Allah aur uss kay Rasool ney hum say kiya tha , aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ney sach kaha tha .  aur iss waqaey ney unn kay emaan aur tabey daari kay jazbay mein aur izafa kerdiya tha .

inhi emaan walon mein woh log bhi hain jinhon ney Allah say jo ehad kiya tha , ussay sacha ker dikhaya . phir unn mein say kuch woh hain jinhon ney apna nazrana poora kerdiya , aur kuch woh hain jo abhi intizar mein hain ,   aur unhon ney ( apney iradon mein ) zara si bhi tabdeeli nahi ki .

. ( yeh waqiaa iss liye huwa ) takay Allah sachon ko unn ki sachai ka inaam dey , aur munafiqon ko agar chahye to azab dey , ya unn ki tauba qubool kerlay .   Allah yaqeenan boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

aur jo log kafir thay , Allah ney unhen unn kay saray ghaiz o ghazab kay sath iss tarah puspa kerdiya kay woh koi faeeda hasil naa ker-sakay . aur mominon ki taraf say larraee kay liye Allah khud kafi hogaya . aur Allah bari quooat ka , baray iqtidar ka malik hai .

aur jinn ehal-e-kitab ney inn ( dushmanon ) ki madad ki thi , unhen Allah unn kay qalon say neechay utaar laya ,   aur unn kay dilon mein aisa roab daal diya kay ( aey musalmano ! ) unn mein say kuch ko tum qatal ker rahey thay , aur kuch ko qedi bana rahey thay .

aur Allah ney tumhen unn ki zameen ka , unn kay gharon ka aur unn ki dolat ka waris bana diya , aur aik aesi zameen ka bhi jiss tak abhi tumharay qadam nahi phonchay   aur Allah her cheez per poori qudrat rakhta hai .
aey nabi ! apni biwiyon say kaho kay :  agar tum dunyawi zindagi aur uss ki zeenat chahti ho to aao , mein tumhen kuch tohfay dey ker khoobsurti kay sath rukhsat kerdun .
aur agar tum Allah aur uss kay Rasool aur aalam-e-aakhirat ki talabgaar ho , to yaqeen jano Allah ney tum mein say naik khawateen kay liye shandaar inaam tayyar ker rakha hai .
aey nabi ki biwiyo ! tum mein say jo koi kissi khuli beyhoodgi ka irtikab keray gi , uss ka azab barha ker do guna kerdiya jaye ga , aur Allah kay liye aisa kerna boht aasaan hai .

aur tum mein say jo koi Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki tabey daar rahey gi , aur naik amal keray gi , ussay hum uss ka sawab bhi do guna den gay , aur uss kay liye hum ney ba-izzat rizq tayyar ker rakha hai .

aey nabi ki biwiyo ! agar tum taqwa ikhtiyar kero to tum aam aurton ki tarah nahi ho .   lehaza tum nazakat kay sath baat matt kiya kero , kabhi koi aisa shaks beyja lalach kernay lagay jiss kay dil mein rog hota hai , aur baat woh kaho jo bhalai wali ho .

aur apney gharon mein qarar kay sath raho ,   aur ( ghair mardon ko ) banao singhaar dikhati naa phiro , jaisa kay pehli jahiliyat mein dikhaya jata tha ,   aur namaz qaeem kero , aur zakat ada kero , aur Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki farmanbardaari kero . aey nabi kay ahl-e-bait ! yani ( ghar walo )   Allah to yeh chahta hai kay tum say gandagi ko door rakhay , aur tumhen aesi pakeezgi ata keray jo her tarah mukammal ho .
aur tumharay gharon mein Allah ki jo aayaten aur hikmat ki jo baaten sunai jati hain , unn ko yaad rakho . yaqeen jano Allah boht bareek-been aur her baat say ba-khabar hai .

beyshak farmanbardaar mard hon ya farmanbardaar aurten ,   momin mard hon ya momin aurten , ibadat guzaar mard hon ya ibadat guzaar aurten , sachay mard hon ya sachi aurten , sabir mard hon ya sabir aurten , dil say jhukney walay mard hon ya dil say jhukney wali aurten ,   sadqa kernay walay mard hon ya sadqa kernay wali aurten , roza daar mard hon ya roza daar aurten , apni sharmgahon ki hifazat kernay walay mard hon ya hifazat kernay wali aurten , aur Allah ka kasrat say ziker kernay walay mard hon ya ziker kernay wali aurten , inn sabb kay liye Allah ney maghfirat aur shandaar ajar tayyar ker rakha hai .

aur jab Allah aur uss ka Rasool kissi baat ka hatmi faisla kerden to naa kissi momin mard kay liye yeh gunjaeesh hai naa kissi momin aurat kay liye kay unn ko apney moamlay mein koi ikhtiyar baqi rahey .   aur jiss kissi ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki nafarmani ki , woh khuli gumrahi mein parr-gaya .

aur ( aey payghumber ! ) yaad kero jab tum uss shaks say jiss per Allah ney bhi ehsan kiya tha , aur tum ney bhi ehsan kiya tha ,   yeh keh rahey thay kay :  apni biwi ko apney nikah mein rehney do , aur Allah say daro    aur tum apney dil mein woh baat chupaye huye thay jissay Allah khol denay wala tha ,   aur tum logon  say dartay thay , halankay Allah iss baat ka ziyada haq daar hai kay tum uss say daro . phir jab zaid ney apni biwi say talluq khatam kerliya to hum ney uss say tumhara nikah keradiya , takay musalmanon kay liye apney mun bolay beton ki biwiyon ( say nikah kernay ) mein uss waqt koi tangi naa rahey jab unhon ney apni biwiyon say talluq khatam kerliya ho . aur Allah ney jo hukum diya tha , uss per amal to ho ker rehna hi tha .

nabi kay liye uss kaam mein aetraz ki koi baat nahi hoti jo Allah ney uss kay liye tey kerdiya ho . yehi Allah ki woh sunnat hai jiss per unn ( anbiya ) kay moamlay mein bhi amal hota aaya hai jo pehlay guzar chukay hain . aur Allah ka faisla napa tula muqaddar hota hai .

payghumber woh log hain jo Allah kay bhejay huye ehkaam ko logon  tak phonchatay hain , aur ussi say dartay hain , aur Allah kay siwa kissi say nahi dartay . aur hisab lenay kay liye Allah ko kissi ki zaroorat nahi .

. ( musalmano ! ) Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) tum mardon mein say kissi kay baap nahi hain , lekin woh Allah kay Rasool hain , aur tamam nabiyon mein sabb say aakhri nabi hain .   aur Allah her baat ko khoob janney wala hai .
aey emaan walo ! Allah ko khoob kasrat say yaad kiya kero ,
aur subha o shaam uss ki tasbeeh kero .
wohi hai jo khud bhi tum per rehmat bhejna hai , aur uss kay farishtay bhi , takay woh tumhen andheron say nikal ker roshni mein ley aaye , aur woh mominon per boht meharban hai .
jiss din momin log Allah say milen gay uss din unn ka istaqbal salam say hoga , aur Allah ney unn kay liye ba-izzat inaam tayyar ker rakha hai .
aey nabi ! beyshak hum ney tumhen aisa bana ker bheja hai kay tum gawahi denay walay , khushkhabri sunaney walay aur khabrdar kernay walay ho ,
aur Allah kay hukum say logon  ko Allah ki taraf bulaney walay , aur roshni phelaney walay chiragh ho .
tum mominon ko khushkhabri suna do kay unn per Allah ki taraf say bara fazal honey wala hai ,
aur kafiron aur munafiqon ki baat naa maano , aur unn ki taraf say jo takleef phonchay , uss ki perwa naa kero , aur Allah per bharosa kiye raho , aur Allah rakhwala banney kay liye kafi hai .

aey emaan walo ! jab tum ney momin aurton say nikah kiya ho , phir tum ney unhen chooney say pehlay hi talaq dey di ho , to unn kay zimmay tumhari koi iddat wajib nahi hai jiss ki ginti tumhen shumar kerni ho .   lehaza unhen kuch tohfa dey do ,   aur unhen khoobsurti say rukhsat kerdo .

aey nabi ! hum ney tumharay liye tumhari woh biwiyan halal kerdi hain jinn ko tum ney unn ka mehar ada kerdiya hai .   neez Allah ney ghaneemat ka jo maal tumhen ata kiya hai , uss mein say jo kaneezen tumhari milkiyat mein aa-chuki hain woh bhi ( tumharay liye halal hain ) aur tumhari woh chacha ki betiyan aur phoopiyon ki betiyan aur mamoo ki betiyan aur khalaon ki betiyan bhi jinhon ney tumharay sath hijrat ki hai ,   neez koi musalman aurat jiss ney mehar kay baghair nabi ko apney aap ( say nikah kernay ) ki paishkash ki ho ,   ba-shartey-kay nabi uss say nikah kerna chahye . yeh saray ehkaam khaas tumharay liye hain , doosray mominon kay liye nahi . hamen woh ehkaam khoob maloom hain jo hum ney unn ki biwiyon aur kaneezon kay baaray mein unn per aaeed kiye hain , ( aur tumhen unn say mustasna kiya hai ) takay tum per koi tangi naa rahey , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala bara meharban hai .

unn biwiyon mein say tum jiss ki baari chahao multawi kerdo , aur jiss ko chahao , apney paas rakho , aur jinn ko tum ney alag kerdiya ho unn mein say agar kissi ko wapis bulana chahao to uss mein bhi tumharay liye koi gunah nahi hai .   iss tareeqay mein iss baat ki ziyada tawaqqo hai kay unn sabb ki aankhen thandi rahen gi , aur unhen ranj nahi hoga , aur tum unhen jo kuch dey do gay , uss per woh sabb ki sabb razi rahen gi .   aur Allah unn sabb baaton ko janta hai jo tumharay dilon mein hain , aur Allah ilm aur hilm ka malik hai .

iss kay baad doosri aurten tumharay liye halal nahi hain , aur naa yeh jaeez hai kay tum unn kay badlay koi doosri biwiyan ley aao , chahye unn ki khoobi tumhen pasand aai ho ,   albatta jo kaneezen tumhari milkiyat mein hon , ( woh tumharay liye halal hain , ) aur Allah her cheez ki poori nigrani kernay wala hai .

aey emaan walo ! nabi kay gharon mein ( bila ijazat ) dakhil naa ho , illa yeh kay tumhen khaney per aaney ki ijazat dey di jaye , woh bhi iss tarah kay tum uss khaney ki tayyari kay intizar mein naa bethay raho , lekin jab tumhen dawat di jaye to jao , phir jab khana kha chuko to apni apni raah lo , aur baaton mein ji laga ker naa betho .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay iss baat say nabi ko takleef phonchti hai , aur woh tum say ( kehtay huye ) sharmatay hain , aur Allah haq baat mein kissi say nahi sharmata . aur jab tumhen nabi ki biwiyon say kuch maangna ho to perday kay peechay say maango .   yeh tareeqa tumharay dilon ko bhi aur unn kay dilon ko bhi ziyada pakeezah rakhney ka zariya hoga . aur tumharay liye jaeez nahi hai kay tum Allah kay Rasool ko takleef phonchao , aur naa yeh jaeez hai kay unn kay baad unn ki biwiyon say kabhi bhi nikah kero . yeh Allah kay nazdeek bari sangeen baat hai .
chahye tum koi baat zahir kero , ya ussay chupao , Allah her cheez ka poora poora ilm rakhney wala hai .

nabi ki biwiyon kay liye apney apney baap ( kay samney bey perda aaney ) mein koi gunah nahi hai , naa apney beton kay , naa apney bhaiyon kay , naa apney bhateejon kay , naa apney bhanjon kay , aur naa apni aurton kay ,   aur naa apni kaneezon kay ( samney aaney mein koi gunah hai . ) aur ( aey khawateen ! ) tum Allah say darti raho . yaqeen jano kay Allah her baat ka mushaeeda kernay wala hai .
beyshak Allah aur uss kay farishtay nabi per durood bhejtay hain . aey emaan walo ! tum bhi unn per durood bhejo , aur khoob salam bheja kero .
jo log Allah aur uss kay Rasool ko takleef phonchatay hain , Allah ney duniya aur aakhirat mein unn per lanat ki hai , aur unn kay liye aisa azab tayyar ker rakha hai jo zaleel ker kay rakh dey ga .
aur jo log momin mardon aur momin aurton ko unn kay kissi jurm kay baghair takleef phonchatay hain , unhon ney bohtan tarazi aur khulay gunah ka bojh apney oopper laad liya hai .

aey nabi ! tum apni biwiyon , apni betiyon aur musalmanon ki aurton say keh do kay woh apni chadaren apney ( mun kay ) oopper jhuka liya keren .   iss tareeqay mein iss baat ki ziyada tawaqqo hai kay woh pehchan li jayen gi , to unn ko sataya nahi jaye ga .   aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

agar woh log baaz naa aaye jo munafiq hain , jinn kay dilon mein rog hai aur jo shehar mein shar-angez afwahen phelatay hain , to hum zaroor aisa keren gay kay tum unn kay khilaf uth kharray hogay , phir woh uss shehar mein tumharay sath nahi reh saken gay , albatta thoray din
jinn mein woh phitkaray huye hon gay . ( phir ) jahan kahen milen gay , pakar liye jayen gay , aur unhen aik aik ker kay qatal kerdiya jaye ga .
yeh Allah ka woh mamool hai jiss per unn logon  kay moamlay mein bhi amal hota raha hai jo pehlay guzar chukay hain . aur tum Allah kay mamool mein koi tabdeeli hergiz nahi pao gay .
log tum say qayamat kay baaray mein poochtay hain . keh do kay uss ka ilm to Allah hi kay paas hai . aur tumhen kiya pata shayad qayamat qareeb hi aagae ho .
iss mein koi shak nahi kay Allah ney kafiron ko rehmat say door kerdiya hai , aur unn kay liye bharakti hoi aag tayyar ki hai ,
jiss mein woh hamesha iss tarah rahen gay kay unhen naa koi himayati mil sakay ga , aur naa koi madadgaar .
jiss din unn kay chehron ko aag mein ulta palta jaye ga , woh kahen gay kay :  aey kaash ! hum ney Allah ki itaat kerli hoti , aur Rasool ka kehna maan liya hota !
aur kahen gay kay :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney apney sardaron aur apney baron ka kehna maana , aur unhon ney hamen raastay say bhatka diya .
aey humaray perwerdigar ! unn ko dugna azab dey , aur unn per aesi lanat ker jo bari bhari lanat ho .

aey emaan walo ! unn logon  ki tarah naa ban jana jinhon ney musa ko sataya tha , phir Allah ney unn ko unn baaton say bari kerdiya jo unn logon  ney banai then .   aur woh Allah kay nazdeek baray rutbay walay thay .
aey emaan walo ! Allah say daro , aur seedhi sachi baat kaha kero ,

Allah tumharay faeeday kay liye tumharay kaam sanwaar dey ga , aur tumharay gunahon ki maghfirat kerday ga . aur jo shaks Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki itaat keray , uss ney woh kamiyabi hasil kerli jo zabardast kamiyabi hai .

hum ney yeh amanat aasmano aur zameen aur paharon per paish ki , to unhon ney uss kay uthaney say inkar kiya , aur uss say darr gaye , aur insan ney uss ka bojh utha liya .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh bara zalim , bara nadan hai .

nateeja yeh hai kay Allah munafiq mardon aur munafiq aurton ko , neez mushrik mardon aur mushrik aurton ko azab dey ga , aur momin mardon aur momin aurton per rehmat kay sath tawajjah farmaye ga . aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
